evidence: The thickness of the iridium film was measured from an area next to a patterned area. The measured thickness of 23 nm agreed with the thickness of iridium film on the SiO2 surface that was in the same process. This is in accordance with the cycle number (1000) and the earlier reported growth rate of 0.23 Å/cycle at 225 °C. In the TiO2 process the purge duration was lengthened substantial to 40 s in order to ensure complete removal of excess precursors, water in particular.
